text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer decided to take on the 
Japanese Derby together with Sakura 
Laurel.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I don't want them to look away from the 
admiration held in their hearts. 
Furthermore, I intended to take full 
responsibility should anything go wrong.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She wants to win the Derby, and defeat 
Narita Brian. With firm determination and 
strong conviction, Sakura Laurel heads 
onto the turf.
